sights.w: NRHP-listed 1910s–20s brick downtown along Plant Street, with the West Orange Trail running down its median, the Saturday farmers market and Plant Street Market.

sights.address: 455 E Plant St, Winter Garden, FL
sights.w: 22-mile rail-trail from Killarney to Apopka through Oakland Nature Preserve and old citrus country; Winter Garden Station is the trailhead hub.
